items.question: Do you accept walk-ins?
items.answer: Yes, we welcome walk-ins whenever possible, though we recommend booking an appointment to guarantee your preferred time slot.

items.question: How often should I visit the dentist?
items.answer: We recommend a checkup and cleaning every six months to maintain optimal oral health, though your dentist may suggest a different schedule based on your needs.

items.question: Do you offer payment plans?
items.answer: Yes, we offer flexible 0% interest installment plans for most major treatments. Speak with our front desk team for details.

items.question: What insurance do you accept?
items.answer: We accept most major insurance providers including Delta Dental, MetLife, Cigna, Aetna, Guardian, and United Healthcare.

items.question: How long does teeth whitening take?
items.answer: In-office professional whitening typically takes about 60–90 minutes and delivers immediate, visible results.

items.question: What should I do in a dental emergency?
items.answer: Call our 24/7 emergency line immediately at +1 (555) 111-9999. For knocked-out teeth, keep the tooth moist and come in as soon as possible.
